name: volunteerny-app
//check:esm: The app's tsconfig uses moduleResolution 'bundler' for Vite, which permits extensionless relative imports. Vercel runs the server as real ESM (package.json type: module), where those throw ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at load time and take the WHOLE API down — a 500 on every route, with a green tsc and a working local dev server. This re-checks the server entry points under nodenext, where the missing .js is a compile error. Do not remove it from lint.
//deps:firebase: Do not bump firebase past 12.13 without running the FULL Playwright suite twice. 12.17.1 was tried on 18 Aug 2026: green alone, but under the full 142-test parallel run the same 5 failure-simulation specs (network-failure, otp-store, lifecycle-ui) failed deterministically both times — cross-file contention, likely the newer SDK holding aborted connections longer and starving the shared dev server. Rolled back rather than shipped, because a suite that is flaky under load can no longer prove anything. The npm audit moderates are transitive in firebase-admin (uuid buffer bounds needs an attacker-controlled buf we never pass; opentelemetry is server-side tracing) — documented, not exploitable here.

scripts.check:esm: tsc --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule server.ts api/index.ts server/emailTemplates.ts server/appUrl.ts
scripts.test:offline: playwright test tests/property-fuzz.spec.ts tests/email-templates.spec.ts tests/opportunity-date.spec.ts tests/otp-store.spec.ts tests/format-date.spec.ts tests/vocabularies.spec.ts tests/matching.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project vny-rules-test "playwright test --config playwright.rules.config.ts"
